statements.status_notes: Debian trixie ships jpeg-Be-more-careful-with-chunked-icc-data.patch (upstream commit 4af78023 for CVE-2025-7345), which introduced the ICC profile free-on-error path without clearing size metadata. The DHI rebuild backports upstream commit efe658674bd103d1c9bf50809d5767a3f6dd5a01 (MR 278), which clears icc_profile_size and icc_profile_size_allocated after that free. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-81893.
